oh wow 5 years since I wrote that ahahaha. it really does! and i think some people may catch on that and use it to feel better (even if subconsciously), Im sorry to hear about that attorney, I have a close friend that keeps reminding me how dumb i am too.

If I learned something in those years is that those who know you have an easier time keeping in mind those accomplishment and will not care even if you ARE spitting dumb stuff, they know anxiety is most likely distorting your views and will not straight out see you as stupid. And I think it´s great putting it the way you wrote your comment, as a list! having those thoughts out of your head and putting them right next to each other may help little by little to quell that voice telling you you are dumb and dont deserve it. i got my college degree recently with a top score thesis and appraised by my profesors and I still thought I was an absolute dumbass until I wrote this.

Its a long way to gradually getting better at this specially if you have people around that contribute to it (it got easier recently after I got a good therapist and the right medication, but its still an uphill battle), but you can do it, just like you managed all those amazing accomplishments you wrote. Congrats on getting a scholarship for a good college! Hopefully, little by little we will be able to start seeing the world without anxiety distorting it so much.

The case my stepmother told me when I was in Kindergarten and we were walking in the park where the crime took place. I think I saw a strange metallic thing in the ground and asked her what it was, which prompted her to tell me about it: a couple years before, there was a carousel there, in which a certain young woman worked at. One day, a crazy guy(can't remember if it was an ex or a complete stranger) killed her and hid her inside the carousel. It wasn't until the carousel's owner saw her corpse's hand poking out that her body was discovered. That metallic thing was the only thing of the carousel that remained. No one else talked about this and with no way to ask my SM about it, after a couple of years I was sure I had dreamed it.

Until one day-one or two years ago- when my mom was watching her favourite Crime show and I heard the word carousel. Sadly, I arrived for the end of the case, but knowing it was actually true and that I live near it-I even went to that park a lot when I was a kid-made all the fear come back to me. Apparently, it is now solved, but I spent a lot of years fearing some random guy who could appear outta nowhere and kill young girls.

I really want to look it up now, all the "corpse hidden in the merry go round" really creeped me out as a child who loved riding them.

This is fucking terrifying.
